LaTeX source and verification code for the paper "Hopf Invariants of Polynomial Maps and Villarceau Spheres" by Deep Bhattacharjee and Ushashi Bhattacharya. This is version 2 of the preprint "Homotopy Groups of Spheres, Hopf Fibrations and Villarceau Circles II" (doi:10.20944/preprints202602.2038.v1).

- `paper/`: amsart source, figures and the compiled PDF (43 pages). `paper/manuscript.tex` is the single-file version.
- `code/checks.py`: 58 numerical and symbolic checks of the identities in the text; they end with `58 checks passed, 0 failed`.
- `figures/make_figures.py`: the nine figures.

Contact: d.bhattacharjee@erl-forschung.de; for GitHub-related contact egspl@proton.me.
